name: Ferryx README and root docs cleanup

definition.name: Ferryx README and root docs cleanup

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Audit the Ferryx repository documentation facts needed to rebuild the root README and classify root Markdown files as current or obsolete.
DELIVERABLE: Return a concise report listing (a) verified project name/purpose, (b) exact setup, development, testing, and packaging commands supported by repository files, (c) every root *.md file with its purpose and evidence of current use or safe-to-remove status, and (d) any user-visible legacy Orca branding found in documentation.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. Do not edit files. Inspect README.md, package.json, subproject package manifests, root Markdown, and references to root Markdown. Respect the project constraint: public/Ferryx-facing documentation must not retain old Orca branding, while internal compatibility identifiers may remain.
VERIFY: Run read-only commands sufficient to ground every recommendation; quote exact file paths and line references where available.
STOP WHEN: Your report provides an evidence-backed classification for every root Markdown file and verified commands for the rewritten README.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Resolve the canonical public GitHub Pages URL for the Ferryx repository and audit how it is deployed.
DELIVERABLE: Return the canonical URL, the repository owner/name and branch if proven, the exact deployment configuration files and relevant settings, and a concise HTTP availability result using curl if network access works.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite plus public GitHub metadata reachable from the configured git remote. Do not edit files.
VERIFY: Inspect git remote and .github workflow/configuration files; run curl -IL against the resolved URL if it can be derived. Clearly distinguish confirmed facts from unavailable network checks.
STOP WHEN: Your report names one evidence-backed Pages URL or reports the precise fact preventing resolution.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Rebuild /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/README.md into a polished, accurate Ferryx README and remove only clearly obsolete root-level Markdown documents.
DELIVERABLE: Edit README.md with an accurate public Ferryx introduction, canonical GitHub Pages link, prerequisites, setup/development/testing/build commands that exist in repository manifests, and concise architecture/contribution guidance. Delete only root *.md files that your own read-only inspection confirms are superseded, unreferenced, or obsolete; preserve current project artifacts. Return a concise list of edits/deletions and validation output.
SCOPE: You may write only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/README.md and delete clearly obsolete root-level *.md files. You may read the entire repository. Do not alter source code, package manifests, workflows, or non-root docs. Public-facing text must say Ferryx, not old Orca branding; do not change internal compatibility identifiers.
VERIFY: First capture a RED baseline by running the Node snippet that reads README.md, extracts URLs matching https://*.github.io, exits 1 when none exist, and prints URLs otherwise; report its failing exit. Then run that snippet after editing and require exit 0, run every README command that is safe and non-interactive, git diff --check, and find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print | sort. Do not create a commit.
STOP WHEN: The README has verified runnable onboarding and canonical Pages link, only justified root Markdown deletions are made, and all stated verification commands are green.

TASK: Independently verify the finished Ferryx README and root Markdown cleanup in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite.
DELIVERABLE: Return a PASS/FAIL report with exact output for: canonical Pages URL extraction from README; curl -IL to that URL; root Markdown inventory; git diff --check; and every non-interactive command documented in README. Inspect the whole README for GitHub-flavored Markdown structure and identify any remaining public old-Orca branding.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. Do not edit files or commit. Treat source code and documentation as read-only.
VERIFY: Execute a Node script that reads README.md, extracts URLs matching https://*.github.io, exits 1 if none exist, and prints URLs otherwise; git diff --check; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print | sort; and concrete safe README commands.
STOP WHEN: All required checks have been run and the report names each PASS or exact blocker without making any edit.
